issue.title: Saved Markdown for every research reference (birth pointer fix and two-week backfill)
issue.description: Every research report the SASE research-highlights file hook turns into a reference carries its saved Markdown, so the Bob Refs Copy card offers C (code block), L (link), and M (Markdown). That holds for every new report on athena and apollo, and for every hook-matched report from the last two weeks.
